work.title: Sangertog gjennem Sundet
Choral Procession through the Sound
Cantate ved Sangfesten i Sommeren 1883
Humoreske for Mandskor og Messinginstrumenter
Humoresque for Male Choir and Brass Instruments

event.corpName: Choirs from Slagelse, Ringsted, Sorø, Skjelskør

history.p: Gade composed the work for the national Choral Festival in Copenhagen in the summer of 1883. It was performed by seventeen choirs in all.

incipText.p: Det er for varmt til at være herinde
Se Trekroner! nej hvor net med sit hvide Taarn det strutter
Dejlige Hveen, du, hvis Navn er knytted til Stjernernes Hære
En Drossel hen over Skibet fløj
Atter det lufter og Brisen kommer!

titlePage.p: Sangertog gjennem Sundet / Cantate ved Sangfesten i Sommeren 1883. / 1. Afreise. / 2. Langs Kysten. / 3. Hveen. / 4. Rongsted. / 5. Ankomst til Kronborg.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 18 staves. Paginated from first music page 1-19. Verso of title page and last page unnumbered. In the lower right-hand corner of the title page Gade's musical signature and "1883". The score consists of vocal parts and the instrumental parts in a short score.

titleStmt.title: Vocal score, autograph (Albert Orth), printer's copy

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink with additions in pencil. Paginated 1-41; last page blank. Heading on p. 1: "Sangertog gjennem ØreSundet. Niels W Gade.". At the end of the music on p. 41 signed and dated: "Albert Orth / d 19 Juli 83." Pages 9-13 and 18-24 in a different hand. Corrections in ink and pencil by Gade and additions of the engraver.
